decision.reasoning_trace: In this session, I evaluated several Bluetooth speakers, filtering out the high volume of accessories like cables, cases, and shelves. My consideration set focused on highly-rated portable speakers from established brands. The JBL Charge 5 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_120) and Flip 5 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_166) are both gold standards for portable audio, while the Bose SoundLink Color (prod_bluetooth_speakers_071) and JBL Go 3 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_129) offered compact alternatives. The INSMY (prod_bluetooth_speakers_128) was included as a strong budget contender. I ultimately chose the JBL Charge 5 because it provides the best combination of sound performance, IP67 durability, and a 20-hour battery life with a built-in power bank feature, justifying its premium price over the smaller models.
